Table with colspan attribute in a header cell

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><thead><tr><th colspan=\"2\">Full Name</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>John</td><td>Doe</td></tr></tbody></table>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
